notes: v0.21.9 (code 83): Create native VRChat world instances using your personal VRChat account, including Public, Friends+, Friends, Invite+, Invite, and permission-checked Group access. Choose region, optional group queue/roles/age gate/avatar performance and VRC+ display name; launch from Explore, worlds, groups and Floating/Quest tools. VRChat sends an invite to your own account automatically after creation. If that invite fails, retry without creating another instance. Includes condensed staff-facing release highlights.
